static_traits.name: Zhang Yu
static_traits.family_status: Family once ran a small restaurant
static_traits.social_status: Has interpersonal support (friends to talk with about personal problems), but the inferiority about cooking is hard to voice; relationships with family are strained because of her negative thoughts
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems yet; has not received psychotherapy yet; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative; slightly tense but candid at first consultation; highly caring about family's evaluations; tending to focus on negative feedback and negate positive evaluations

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my family will never like any dish I make, this pains me greatly, and also affects my passion for cooking.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inferiority have begun to affect my love of cooking and overall physical and mental health.
growth_experiences: Background of the family of origin: the family once ran a small restaurant; the client places great importance on family members' evaluations of food, which laid the foundation for taking family feedback as an important reference for self-worth.

Receiving mixed reviews after cooking for family once: some family praised, some criticized; initial pressure moderate, but since then when at Family gatherings or needing to cook for family, the client repeatedly experiences Anxiety in advance, presetting negative feedback, focusing on negative comments and ignoring positive evaluations, gradually leading to worsened inferiority, Strained relationships with family members, Declining passion for cooking and changed eating habits.

core_beliefs: My family will not recognize my efforts

special_situations.event: When Starting to prepare to cook for the family, recalling the mixed reviews received last time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any criticism appears, it means I am a terrible cook
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practicing twice as much, attending cooking classes, trying new recipes, and actively asking for feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not like it this time either

special_situations.event: Needing to prepare meals for family at Family gatherings or activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot satisfy everyone, it equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking for family or dawdles before serving

special_situations.event: Hearing neutral or mixed feedback after serving dishes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Every comment from others directly indicates my worth and ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Fixates attention on negative details, ignores positive information
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are picking faults with me; I am just a terrible Chef

special_situations.event: Family gives clear positive feedback or shows enjoyment
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is just politeness or perfunctoriness, does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive experiences, continuing to look for negative evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite, do not really like it

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and appreciated by family (hoping one's cooking is genuinely liked)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being criticized and negated, worrying oneself is not good enough, being looked down upon
defense_goal: By negating positive feedback to maintain self-consistent cognition
Avoiding cooking for family to dodge criticism

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, a Chef who may be negated at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others emphasize the family's past positive feedback and ask about exceptions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing praise is just politeness or beautified, the truth remains that oneself is not good enough
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently pointing out the lack of evidence for her inferences, use open-ended Questioning and concretizing Guidance, tone steady, not confrontational, inviting her back to facts and observable details.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Before serving or in scenes of talking about cooking for family
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing possible criticism as inevitable failure, believing oneself 'never good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First Empathizing with her worries, then Guiding situational differentiation and evidence examination, tone gentle, encouraging her to identify possible multiple outcomes.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling family criticism or worrying about being reproached
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Turning dissatisfaction and anger toward family into self-blame, Reinforcing the cognition of 'I am a terrible Chef'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a supportive tone, distinguishes facts from evaluation, invites them to express feelings about others' evaluations, while practicing self-compassion language.

manifestations: Once loved cooking; now feels the passion is lost because of family evaluations
Difficulty drawing meaning from positive feedback in cooking, continuously negating positive experiences
Filled with Anxiety and Anticipation of failure before cooking for family

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Takes family members' evaluations as the only standard for measuring self-worth
Believes 'only making everyone satisfied counts as success'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets the family's positive feedback as 'just politeness', speculating others' real thoughts are negative
When not yet receiving feedback, presetting that others will not like it

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequently self-blaming as 'a terrible Chef', excessively nervous and cautious before serving
Avoids cooking for family to escape possible criticism

exception_events.target_problem: In the situation of cooking for family, the client usually experiences Anxiety in advance, presets negative feedback, and only focuses on criticism after serving, leading to Relationship tension and boredom with cooking.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Several times the family did show they enjoyed his cooking and gave positive feedback; the outcome at the time was more positive than before.
exception_events.reason: Clue: the family's actual reactions are more positive, letting her briefly see evidence different from the dominant narrative.

positive_force: Was once full of enthusiasm for cooking and had the willingness to invest continuously
Proactively takes cooking courses, tries new recipes, and seeks feedback
Has interpersonal support (has friends to confide in)
Willing to accept counseling and try behavioral experiments, positive attitude
Work performance is stable; life has a certain structure and discipline
negative_force: Strongly depends on family's external evaluations to define self-worth
Significant cognitive distortions (negating the positive, mental filtering, mind reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization, personalization)
Highly Anxious and Anticipating failure before serving
Avoids cooking for family, further solidifying negative beliefs
Strained relationships with family members, increasing the negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Significant Anxiety and avoidance appearing when cooking for family
antecedent: Starting to prepare to cook for the family
Needing to cook at Family gatherings or activities
Recalling past mixed reviews before serving
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly caring about family's evaluations, Introjecting the standard of 'must satisfy everyone'; cognitive distortions (mental filtering, negating the positive, mind reading, predicting the future, overgeneralization) leading to Self-denial and Anticipation of failure
target_behavior.function: Avoiding criticism and negative emotions, trying to lower Anxiety and maintain Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Declining passion for cooking, changed eating habits, Strained relationships with family members, persistent Self-denial and pain
